name: Chip
summary: A value someone picked and can change or remove (an input chip), or a filter they turn on or off (a filter chip). Not for information the system set (Badge), an action (Button, even a compact one), navigation (Link), or a binary setting (Switch). Sets of chips go in a ChipGroup, which owns the label, the keys and the overflow.
a11y: An input chip is its words (a button when it has `onPress`) and a Remove button named "Remove" plus the label; Delete or Backspace on the chip removes it too. A filter chip is one button with `role` checkbox (or radio in a single group) and `aria-checked`, its check drawn as well as its tint. At least 24 px tall; focus rings are never clipped.

keys.action: turn a filter on or off; run the primary action

props.name: label
props.description: The value's name, in sentence case: a person, a label, a filter. Long names truncate; the full name stays in the accessible name.

props.name: kind
props.description: `input`: a value someone picked (removable with `onRemove`, read-only without). `filter`: a filter turned on or off. Default `input`.

props.name: selected
props.description: Filter: it's on. Shows the check and a tint, never colour alone.

props.name: selection
props.description: Filter: `multiple` (a checkbox, default) or `single` (a radio among its group). Set by ChipGroup.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Input: removes the value; shows the Remove button, named "Remove" plus the label.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Input: opens more about the value (a person's card). The words become a button.

props.name: icon
props.description: A leading icon from the active set.

props.name: avatar
props.description: A person: their initials (or picture) before the name. Decorative: the label names them.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Input: the value isn't accepted (an unknown address): danger tone and an error icon; say why in the group's message.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Can't be changed now. Prefer hiding the chip or saying why.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Input chips: `outline` (default) on open surfaces; `filled`, a tonal fill with no outline, inside a bordered field (a tag input), so the field's border is the only enclosure.

props.name: tabIndex
props.description: Set by ChipGroup to keep one Tab stop: the chip's focusable part gets this.

props.name: focusRef
props.description: Set by ChipGroup: the chip's focusable part.

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: Set by ChipGroup: keys on the chip's focusable part.
